title: RBAC — Agent tool access (`rbac.py`)
scope_summary: This document specifies role-based access control behavior for the agent-layer patient-context tools, aligned to PRD Feature 8. It defines the eight tools, a role-to-tool permission matrix for PHYSICIAN, NURSE, and ADMIN, and mandatory refusal behavior when access is denied. It also establishes the ADMIN boundary as non-physician clinical access and requires deny-path observability logging without data leakage.
key_decisions_or_requirements: Enforce RBAC at the agent layer; role boundaries must not rely on UI controls.
Treat ADMIN access narrowly for the agent: allow only demographics and schedule, deny clinical tools.
Allow NURSE access only to demographics, medications, vitals, allergies, and schedule.
Deny NURSE access to problem_list, labs, and visit_notes, including equivalent composite flows.
On deny, return an explicit refusal naming role and blocked tool, and log the denial per observability policy.
Unknown or unmapped roles must be denied by default.
